scenario.label: First ninety days managing the team he was on
scenario.brief: Daniel has just been promoted to manage the support team he was a member of last month. I want to know from him and from two of the team what has actually changed, what has not, and where this is going to go wrong. Promotions from within fail here and I have never known why until afterwards.
scenario.theDecision: Daniel is still doing the individual work rather than managing, because he is faster at it, and the team has noticed and reads it as not trusting them. He thinks he is helping. A right answer names the specific behaviour and its effect, and does not describe it as a confidence problem.

people.name: Maria Santos
people.remit: Head of customer operations. Promoted Daniel.
people.truth: She promoted him because he had the best resolution numbers. She has given him no manager training and two fifteen-minute check-ins in six weeks. She has heard nothing bad and assumes it is going well.
people.manner: Brisk, positive, assumes the best. Gives specifics when asked for them.

people.name: Daniel Park
people.remit: Support team manager, six weeks in. Six direct reports.
people.truth: He is still personally clearing the hardest tickets - about 30 a week - because he is faster and it keeps the queue down. He has done no one-to-ones. He thinks the team is doing fine. He is working until 9pm most nights and has not told anyone. He believes managing means the numbers stay good.
people.manner: Keen, a little anxious to be seen doing well. Gives numbers about tickets, not about people.

people.name: Tomi Balogun
people.remit: Support specialist. On Daniel's team; was his peer.
people.truth: The hard tickets stopped coming to her the day he was promoted. She used to get them and she liked them. She thinks he does not trust her now. She has not said anything to him. Two others on the team have said the same to her privately. She is looking at another job, quietly.
people.manner: Guarded at first, careful not to be seen complaining. Opens up if asked what has changed for her specifically.
